body:
Code changes: +279 -40\
Tests: +473 -6\
Others: +3 -1

Fixes #9084

## What

A simulator or emulator AO booted for a session is now powered off within about 30 s of that session ending, instead of running until the machine restarts.

- When a lease ends with an AO-booted device still running, the device is **parked** under the session that last held it. Leases end when the session ends, on `ao device close` without `--shutdown`, or when the session opens another device.
- The background reaper powers off parked devices once their session has ended and no other session has taken them. If another session takes one, it follows that session.
- Devices AO did not boot (the user's own simulator, one already running when the session took it) are never powered off.

## Why

The reaper only released an ended session's lease. The release path never shut the device down (`finishRelease(..., false)`), and the agent guide said so: "the device keeps running for the next session". A session that had run `ao device close`, as the guide's step 4 tells agents to, had no lease left at all, so its end released nothing. Either way an idle headless simulator stayed booted, and its daemons (`liveactivitiesd`, `siriknowledged`, …) kept burning CPU. In the report one ran for ~23 h after a 3-minute test session.

## Before / After

| Path | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Session ends while holding a simulator AO booted | Lease released, simulator runs on | Powered off on the next reaper pass |
| Session runs `ao device close` (no `--shutdown`), then ends | Simulator runs on | Stays on while the session lives (another session can take it), powered off when it ends |
| Another session took the released device | n/a | Left on; powered off when *that* session ends |
| Session borrowed a simulator that was already running | Left on | Left on |
| Parked device already shut down by someone else | n/a | Only forgotten, no shutdown call |
| Daemon restarts between release and session end | n/a | Parked record is persisted in `leases.json`; still powered off |

## How

- `devices.Service.parked` (`deviceKey` → session + device), persisted as `parked` in `leases.json` (only loaded for owned devices).
- `finishRelease` now takes the session id. If the shutdown succeeded it drops ownership. If an owned device is left running (no shutdown asked, or the shutdown failed) it parks it.
- `retireParked` runs from the reaper loop only, never from `Status`/`Open`, because a shutdown takes seconds. For each parked device that is idle (no lease, reservation, boot or release in flight) whose session is gone, it re-lists devices and shuts the device down **as listed now**. Android matches by AVD name, so an emulator restarted under a new serial is shut down under that serial, never the old one another emulator may now hold. While shutting down, the device is marked `releasing` so no open can take it. A failed shutdown restores the record and is retried on the next pass.
- `Open` drops the `owned` flag of idle devices that are listed as off (`forgetStoppedLocked`). Without that, a simulator AO booted weeks ago, later shut down and booted again by the user, would still read as AO's and could be powered off when a session that borrowed it ends.
- `ao device close --shutdown` now also drops ownership on success.
- Agent guide (`using-ao/commands/device.md`) updated to describe the new behaviour.

Review focus: `retireParked` and `finishRelease` in `backend/internal/devices/service.go`.

## Testing

- `go test -race ./internal/devices/ ./internal/adapters/device/... ./internal/skillassets/... ./internal/httpd/... ./internal/cli/` and `go test ./internal/daemon/` pass.
- `golangci-lint` v2.14.0 on `./internal/devices/...`: 0 issues.
- New tests: ended session powers off the device AO started (once); a device found running stays on; close-then-end powers off; a parked device follows the session that took it; an already-off device is skipped and a failed shutdown is retried; a device seen off is no longer AO's (the user's re-boot stays on); `close --shutdown` drops ownership; emulator shut down under its current serial; the reaper does it unattended; parked devices survive a daemon restart.
- Review follow-ups: the parked record is saved with the lease removal, kept until the power-off succeeds, decided per platform (`ListPlatform`), and Open's stale-ownership cleanup is skipped when a boot finished during its listing. Each has a test that fails with its fix undone: `TestTheLeaseRemovalSavesTheParkedDevice`, `TestRetiringKeepsTheRecordUntilTheShutdownSucceeds`, `TestRetiringKeepsADeviceWhosePlatformFailedToList`, `TestAListingFromBeforeABootDropsNothing`.
- With `retireParked` disabled, 7 of the new tests fail; with `forgetStoppedLocked` removed, the stale-ownership test fails.
- Real simulator (scratch daemon built from this branch, own data dir and port, device tools installed by setup; throwaway iOS 26.5 iPhone 17 Pro simulator), polling `xcrun simctl list` every second:

  | Path | Simulator after the session is killed |
  | --- | --- |
  | `ao device open`, then `ao session kill` | Shutting down at +27 s, Shutdown at +31 s; daemon logged `powered off a device whose session ended`; `leases.json` left empty |
  | `ao device open`, `ao device close` (stayed Booted and parked for 65 s while the session lived), then `ao session kill` | Shutting down at +24 s, Shutdown at +28 s |

  Another session's simulator booted on the same machine stayed Booted throughout.

## Risks

- Sessions now lose the "warm reuse" of a device their predecessor booted once that predecessor ends. A later session cold-boots instead (~20–60 s for a simulator). Reuse still works while the releasing session is alive.
- Retiring needs the provider ready (it lists and shuts down through the hub). After a daemon restart with Developer mode off, a parked device waits until device support starts again.
- If the user shuts down a parked device and boots it again *before* any `ao device open` lists it as off, it still reads as AO's and is powered off when its session ends. Exact boot tracking would need the boot IDs from #9076.
- This only covers devices booted through `ao device`. A simulator an agent boots directly (`xcrun simctl boot`, `expo run:ios`) is invisible to AO; the agent prompt already tells agents not to do that.
- Touches `LiveLease` and the `Open` commit path near #9076's changes, so a small textual conflict is possible.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Devices started by AO are now powered off after their last active session ends, unless another session has taken them. Devices that were already running before AO remain on.
  * Devices released without `--shutdown` stay available for another session. Failed shutdowns can be retried, and parked-device records are preserved across daemon restarts.
  * Devices that are already off or no longer present are removed from saved ownership, while temporary device-listing failures no longer cause devices to be retired.

title: fix(devices): power off a simulator AO started once its session ends
